That is contrary to the way the media portrays him.  The media generally
portrays Kaczynski as a serial killer who enjoyed killing then wrote the
Manifesto in order to justify his behavior.

After reading the Manifesto numerous times I still have trouble finding
flaws in his arguments.  He certainly is right about our dependence on
technology and the industrial system.  My neighborhood experienced a
power outage for several hours the other day and we were worse off than
in the dark ages.  There was nothing to do except stare at the candle.
We couldn't cook anything, our food was in danger of spoiling, and we
couldn't even drive anywhere because the traffic lights were out.
